title: Accuracy Eval Manifest (v3.1 scaffolding)
description: Schema for manifests describing golden datasets and fixture collections for the AlgorithmLens accuracy harness.

version.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema (e.g., 1.0.0).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was created.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was last updated.

dataset_type.description: Type of dataset this manifest describes.

name.description: Human-readable name for this dataset or fixture collection.

description.description: Long-form description of what this dataset covers.

scans.description: List of scan or fixture entries included in this dataset.

id.description: Unique identifier for this scan or fixture (e.g., golden_001, FIX_EMPTY).

scenario.description: Short label for the scenario (e.g., high_ad_density, FIX_MINIMAL).

platform.description: Platform for this scan (e.g., tiktok, instagram, youtube).

input_path.description: Relative path to the input JSON for this scan/fixture.

expected_output_path.description: Relative path to the expected analysis output JSON, if defined.
